A 3-credit course taught by Prof. Hugo de Souza Oliveira. These are the lecture notes for the course.

::: {.grid} ::: {.g-col-6} ### [Class 2 — Springs, Dampers & Free Vibration](class2.qmd) Combining springs and dampers in series and parallel. Deriving the equation of motion from a free body diagram. Natural frequency. Free vibration response and initial conditions. **Interactive:** Free vibration explorer — change $m$, $k$, $u_0$, $v_0$. ::: ::: {.g-col-6} ### [Class 3 — Forced Vibration (Undamped)](class3.qmd) Harmonic excitation of an undamped system. Homogeneous and particular solutions. Resonance. Phase shift and the phasor diagram. Introduction to damped forced vibration. **Interactive:** Frequency response and time-domain explorer. ::: ::: {.g-col-6} ### [Class 4 — Damped Forced Vibration & Dimensionless Form](class4.qmd) Completing the damped forced response derivation. Amplitude $U$ and phase $\phi$. Behaviour at resonance. Dimensionless parameters ($\zeta$, $r$, $c_c$). Bode plots. **Interactive:** Bode plot explorer — drag $\zeta$ and overlay multiple curves. ::: ::: {.g-col-6} ### [Class 5 — Free Damped Systems](class5.qmd) Euler identity and complex notation. Characteristic equation. Underdamped, critically damped, and overdamped cases. Logarithmic decrement for experimental damping identification. **Interactive:** Free response explorer — watch the transition between all three regimes. ::: ::: {.g-col-6} ### [Class 6 — Transmissibility](class6.qmd) Force transmissibility and motion transmissibility. The isolation threshold at $r = \sqrt{2}$. Base excitation: relative and absolute displacement. The damping trade-off. **Interactive:** Transmissibility explorer — drag $\zeta$ and $r$, overlay $U/Y$ and $T_F$, compare curves. ::: ::: {.g-col-6} ### [Class 7 — Introduction to 2DOF Systems](class7.qmd) From SDOF to two-degree-of-freedom systems. Coupled equations of motion. Matrix form. Eigenvalue problem. Natural frequencies and mode shapes for the general and symmetric cases. **Interactive:** Natural frequencies and mode shapes explorer — change $m_1$, $m_2$, $k_1$, $k_2$. ::: ::: {.g-col-6} ### [Class 8 — Forced Vibration & Dynamic Vibration Absorber](class8.qmd) Forced 2DOF response. Dynamic stiffness matrix. Resonance and anti-resonance. The dynamic vibration absorber: tuning condition, physical interpretation, and design. **Interactive:** DVA frequency response explorer — change mass ratio $\mu$ and tuning ratio $f$. ::: :::
